question: 17 is related to 52 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 42 is related to 127. To which of the following is 29 related to, following the same logic?
solution:
Logic : (1st number × 3) + 1 = 2nd number

Given : 

__
 
• 17 is related to 52

(17 × 3)__ + 1 = 52

__**51 **____**+ 1**__ = 52

52 = 52 (LHS = RHS)

And,

__
 
• 42 is related to 127

(42 × 3)__ + 1 = 127

__126 ____+ 1__ = 127

127 = 127 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

__
 
• 29 is related to

(29 × 3)__ + 1 = ?

__87 ____+ 1__ = ?

**88 = ?**

Hence, "88" is the correct answer.
